patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Adyen Variable, Adyen Mono, Adyen UI.
<Alert> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: type, variant, title, description, icon, onClose, actions, children, style.
<Alert> variant must be one of 'default' | 'tip'.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, initials, name, size, style.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, critical, condensed, disabled, inverse, iconLeft, iconRight, iconOnly, type, onClick, children, style.
<Button> type must be one of 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'.
<Card> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, description, background, clickable, headerActions, footer, onClick, children, style.
<Card> background must be one of 'primary' | 'secondary'.
<Checkbox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, indeterminate, onChange, disabled, label, description, id, style.
<Chip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, disabled, readonly, error, condensed, onRemove, style.
<Divider> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: orientation, style.
<Divider> orientation must be one of 'horizontal' | 'vertical'.
<EmptyState> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, title, description, action, children, style.
<Icon> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, size, color, base, title, style.
<IconButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, variant.

<InputField> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, description, placeholder, value, defaultValue, onChange, type, condensed, disabled, readonly, error, errorMessage, iconBefore, iconAfter, staticValue, staticValuePosition, hint, id, style.
<InputField> staticValuePosition must be one of 'start' | 'end'.
<Link> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: href, variant, external, children, style.
<Link> variant must be one of 'primary' | 'quiet'.
<LoadingIndicator> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: size, color, style.
<MenuItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label, icon, shortcut, disabled, critical, divider.
<Modal> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: open, title, description, footer, onClose, width, children, style.
<Pagination> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: page, total, onChange, style.
<RadioOption> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label, description, disabled.
<SegmentOption> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label, icon.
<SelectionCard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: selected, disabled, control, title, description, icon, onSelect, children, style.
<SelectionCard> control must be one of 'radio' | 'checkbox'.
<Status> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, label, children, style.
<StepItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label.
<TabItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label, icon, count.
<Tag> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, variant, icon, children, style.
<Textarea> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, description, placeholder, value, defaultValue, onChange, rows, disabled, readonly, error, errorMessage, id, style.
<Toast> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: message, action, onAction, onClose, icon, style.
<Toggle> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, onChange, disabled, readonly, label, description, labelFirst, id, style.
<Tooltip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: content, placement, children, style.
<Tooltip> placement must be one of 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'.
